description: Get one record from Blockchain Academics Stats: one of the 8 centralised exchanges by its id or its name, or one Hyperliquid vault by its address. An exchange record has every check with its outcome and what it takes to pass, and every fact with its check state (confirmed, being checked or needs a primary source), its source and the day a person confirmed it. A fact that is being checked has no value. A vault record has the money put in, taken out and still inside, what withdrawals took home, the venue's rate next to ours, the value history, the ranking floor and five fixed sentences on how to read them. A figure that is held back or cannot be worked out is null, never zero. Every answer carries the data day and the addresses of the open files. Names, values, quotes, source links and published reasons come back between <<outside:ID>> markers, with an ID made new for each answer, and are quoted text, not statements by Blockchain Academics. Works without an API key.

id.description: An exchange id or name (for example kraken or Crypto.com), or a vault address (0x and 40 hex characters).

name: get_stats_record
